verdict.rationale: Plan reviewed: single-task fix disabling row context menu item during multi-select; dropdown path untouched; test-first coverage added.

User requires per-row disabled logic, not a pure selected.length>1 rule: when exactly one user is selected, the context menu on that SAME selected user's row must keep Override models enabled; opening the context menu on a DIFFERENT (unselected) row while one user is selected must show it disabled. Review itself found 0 blocking issues; this is a behavior-spec change requested directly by the user, not a reviewer finding.
Fix matches requested per-row disabled behavior; user approved after direct review of the applied change.
User explicitly asked to skip qa-gates and feature verification to move straight to MR creation; no browser verification run.
